DATA FLOW DIAGRAM (DFD) LEVEL 0: DIAGRAM KONTEKS SISTEM SMART METER 3-FASA
Diagram Konteks Kotak Hitam (Black Box): Aliran Data Masukan & Keluaran Global antara Sistem Smart Meter (STM32U585 & ADE9000) dan Entitas Eksternal (Acuan: Desain Sistem, PIN.docx & SPLN D3.006:2021)

0.0
SISTEM SMART METER 3-FASA TERTANAM
(Host MCU STM32U585 Cortex-M33 & AFE ADE9000)
Standar SPLN D3.006:2021 Kelas 1.0

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
JARINGAN LISTRIK & CATU DAYA PLN
- Trafo Tegangan (Va, Vb, Vc) & Arus (Ia, Ib, Ic, In)
- Sinyal Deteksi Padam AC_FAIL_DET (PC3)
- Sinyal Zero-Crossing ADE_CF3_ZX (PE8)
- Monitor Baterai VBAT (PD11) & VCAP (PC2)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
VEKTOR SABOTASE & ANOMALI FISIK
- Saklar Buka Tutup Meter (PC13 / TAMP_IN1)
- Saklar Buka Tutup Terminal (PE6 / TAMP_IN3 - ERR20)
- Sensor Magnetik Hall Effect (PE4 / EXTI4 - ERR25)
- Anomali Listrik AFE (PB5 IRQ0 & PB1 IRQ1: ERR21..27)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
PELANGGAN LISTRIK
- Tombol Navigasi Layar (PA0 UP / PB6 DOWN)
- Konfirmasi Rekoneksi Simultan (▲+▼ >= 1s)
- Display OLED 0.96" SSD1306 (Power PD2 / BL PD3)
- Indikator LED Alarm (PB7) & Buzzer (PB8)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
INSTALASI BEBAN & KONTROL BANTU
- Pasokan Daya Listrik Terhubung / Terputus
- Koil Latching Relai Trip (PC8) / Close (PC9)
- Kontak Umpan Balik Relai AUX (PC6 / PC7)
- Sinyal Kontrol Bantu AUX_IN (PD10/14) & AUX_OUT (PD8)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
PETUGAS PLN (HHU) & BANGKU UJI TERA
- Port Optik Depan IEC 62056-21 (USART3 PB10/PB11)
- Audit Billing Bulanan, Profil Beban & 3 Logbook FIFO
- Konfigurasi Lokal IDPEL, Meter ID & Tarif ToU
- Pulsa Tera Optik CF1/CF2 (PE12/PE13) & Konsol CLI

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
SISTEM PUSAT PLN (HES / AMI SYSTEM)
- Modem Seluler 4G/NB-IoT (USART2/LPUART1 PA2/PA3, PD5)
- Port Serial RS-485/RS-232 (USART1 PA9/PA10, DE PA12, PD4)
- Perintah Disconnect/Reconnect (Cls 70), Set ToU & RTC
- Penerima APDU DLMS AES-GCM-128, Trap & Last-Gasp

Respons Frame HDLC, Pulsa CF1/CF2
(PE12/13) & Status Log CLI

Perintah Audit OBIS, Set IDPEL
(Optik USART3) & Uji CLI

Perintah Disconnect Cls 70,
Set ToU/Kontrak & Sync RTC

APDU DLMS (AES-128), Profil Beban
90-Hari, Trap & Last-Gasp

DATA FLOW DIAGRAM (DFD) LEVEL 1: DEKOMPOSISI TIGA PILAR SISTEM SMART METER
Dekomposisi Fungsional Tingkat Sub-Sistem: Pilar E1 (Metrologi ADE9000) → Pilar E3 (Logika Aplikasi SPLN D3.006) ↔ Pilar E2 (Protokol DLMS/COSEM)

1.0
SUB-SISTEM METROLOGI & DSP
(PILAR E1 - IC AFE ADE9000)
- Sampling ADC SPI1 8kSPS (PA4..PA7)
- Kalkulasi RMS V, I, P, Q, S, PF & Frekuensi
- Deteksi Anomali Listrik (PB5 IRQ0 / PB1 IRQ1)
- Output Pulsa Tera Optik CF1/CF2 (PE12/PE13)

3.0
SUB-SISTEM LOGIKA APLIKASI & SISTEM
(PILAR E3 - JANTUNG METER)
- Engine Billing Bulanan & Tarif ToU 8-Zona
- Profil Beban 15-Menit (23-Kanal, 90 Hari) & Peak MD
- Pengelola Relai Kontaktor & Proteksi (SPLN D3.006)
- Evaluasi 9 Vektor Tamper, 8 Alarm HW & 12 Event
- Antarmuka HMI OLED (PD2/PD3), Tombol & LED (PB7)
- Manajemen Daya Last-Gasp (<15ms, PC3) & Konsol CLI

2.0
SUB-SISTEM PROTOKOL DLMS/COSEM
(PILAR E2)
- Framing HDLC Modem (USART2/LPUART1) & Optik (USART3)
- Keamanan Kriptografi HLS-5 AES-GCM-128
- Katalog Objek OBIS (Class 1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 70)
- Parser Layanan APDU GET / SET / ACTION & Push

D1..D4 | MEMORI PERSISTEN NVM (NOR FLASH SPI2 W25Q32 4MB PB12..15 & INTERNAL)
D1: Checkpoint Energi & Relai | D2: 3 Logbook FIFO (Alarm, Event, Tamper >=30 Entri) | D3: Profil Beban 90-Hari & Billing 12-Bln | D4: Tarif ToU & IDPEL

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
JARINGAN LISTRIK & CATU DAYA PLN
- Trafo Tegangan (Va..Vc) & Arus (Ia..In)
- Sinyal Deteksi Padam AC_FAIL_DET (PC3)
- Sinyal Zero-Crossing ADE_CF3_ZX (PE8)
- Sinyal VBAT (PD11) & VCAP (PC2)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
SENSOR SABOTASE FISIK
- Saklar Buka Tutup Meter (PC13 / TAMP_IN1)
- Saklar Buka Terminal (PE6 / TAMP_IN3 - ERR20)
- Sensor Magnetik Hall Effect (PE4 / EXTI4 - ERR25)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
PELANGGAN LISTRIK
- Tombol Navigasi Layar (PA0 UP / PB6 DN)
- Konfirmasi Rekoneksi Simultan (▲+▼ >= 1s)
- Display OLED SSD1306 (PD2/PD3)
- Indikator LED Alarm (PB7) & Buzzer (PB8)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
INSTALASI BEBAN & KONTROL BANTU
- Pasokan Daya Terhubung / Terputus
- Koil Breaker Trip (PC8) / Close (PC9)
- Kontak Umpan Balik Relai AUX (PC6 / PC7)
- Kontrol Bantu AUX_IN (PD10/14) & AUX_OUT (PD8)

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
SISTEM PUSAT PLN (HES / AMI)
- Modem 4G/NB-IoT (USART2/LPUART1 PA2/PA3, PD5)
- Port RS-485/RS-232 (USART1 PA9/PA10, PD4)
- Perintah Disconnect Cls 70, Set ToU & Sync RTC
- Penerima APDU DLMS, Trap & Last-Gasp

ENTITAS EKSTERNAL:
PETUGAS PLN (HHU) & BANGKU UJI TERA
- Port Optik Depan IEC 62056-21 (USART3 PB10/PB11)
- Audit Billing Bulanan & 3 Logbook FIFO
- Pulsa Tera Optik CF1/CF2 (PE12/PE13)
- Konsol Uji Diagnostik Serial CLI (USART2)

Perintah Cls 70, Set ToU/IDPEL
& Sync RTC

Perintah HES, Set Tarif
& Sync RTC

DATA FLOW DIAGRAM (DFD) LEVEL 2: DEKOMPOSISI PROSES 3.0 (PILAR E3 - APLIKASI SMART METER)
Dekomposisi Kompak 5 Sub-Proses Inti (3.1–3.5) & 3 Data Store Terlokalisasi (D1–D3) dengan Panah Searah Murni (Sesuai Design For ECE, Desain Sistem, PIN.docx & SPLN D3.006:2021)

SUBSISTEM METROLOGI
(PILAR E1 - IC AFE ADE9000)
- Sampling SPI1 ADE9000 (PA4..PA7)
- Vektor Pengukuran s_meas (V, I, P, Q, S, PF)
- IRQ Anomali Listrik PB5 (IRQ0) & PB1 (IRQ1)

SENSOR SABOTASE FISIK
(TAMPER HARDWARE)
- Saklar Tutup Meter (PC13 / TAMP_IN1)
- Saklar Tutup Terminal (PE6 / TAMP_IN3 - ERR20)
- Sensor Magnetik Hall (PE4 / EXTI4 - ERR25)

DETEKSI DAYA & GRID
(POWER & ZX MONITOR)
- Sinyal Padam AC_FAIL_DET (PC3)
- Sinyal Zero-Crossing ADE_CF3_ZX (PE8)
- Monitor VBAT (PD11) & VCAP (PC2)

D1 | MEMORI TARIF ToU, PROFIL BEBAN (90-HR) & BILLING (12-BLN)
Skedul WBP/LWBP 8-Zona, Kontrak VA, IDPEL, Profil 15-M (23-Kanal) & Peak MD (SPI2 4MB)

3.1
ENGINE BILLING, TARIF ToU
& PROFIL BEBAN (15-M)
Kalkulasi Energi WBP/LWBP, Billing 12-Bln,
Integrasi 23-Kanal 15-M (90-Hr), Peak MD,
& Konfigurasi Kontrak/RTC

3.2
DETEKSI SABOTASE (9 TAMPER),
ALARM & LOGBOOK FIFO
Evaluasi 9 Vektor Tamper, 8 Alarm HW
(ERR00..27), 12 Event, & Pencatatan
3 Antrean Logbook FIFO

3.4
ANTARMUKA HMI OLED,
TOMBOL & KONSOL CLI
25 Layar SPLN (Auto 5s / Manual), Rotasi
ERR 3s, Kedip LED PB7, Buzzer PB8,
& Parser Diagnostik CLI (USART2)

PELANGGAN LISTRIK
- Tombol Navigasi (PA0 UP / PB6 DN) & (▲+▼ 1s)
- Display OLED SSD1306 (PD2/PD3)
- Indikator LED Alarm (PB7) & Buzzer (PB8)

D2 | 3 REGISTER LOGBOOK FIFO (>= 30 ENTRI/LOG)
Antrean FIFO Terpisah: Log Alarm (8), Log Event (12) & Log Tamper (9)

3.3
PENGELOLA RELAI &
PROTEKSI (SPLN D3.006)
FSM Relai (CONNECTED, READY,
LOCKED OUT), Zero-Cross Switch,
Proteksi Beban/Tegangan & AUX

3.5
MANAJEMEN DAYA &
LAST-GASP (STOP 2)
Emergency Save (<15ms) ke D3,
Wakeup Layar 10s saat Padam,
Power Gating & Stop 2 (4.5µA)

D3 | FLASH CHECKPOINT ENERGI & STATUS RELAI
Simpan Darurat Last-Gasp (<15ms) & Restorasi Saat Boot

PROTOKOL DLMS/COSEM
(PILAR E2)
- Modem HES USART2/LPUART1 (AES-128)
- Port Optik HHU USART3 (PB10/PB11)
- Layanan GET / SET / ACTION Objek OBIS
- Perintah Disconnect Cls 70 & Sync RTC Cls 8

INSTALASI BEBAN & KONTROL BANTU
- Pasokan Daya Terhubung / Terputus
- Koil Latching Relai Trip (PC8) / Close (PC9)
- Kontak Umpan Balik Relai AUX (PC6 / PC7)
- Kontrol Bantu AUX_IN (PD10/14) & AUX_OUT (PD8)

PORT UJI & DIAGNOSTIK
(PETUGAS / TEST BENCH)
- Serial CLI Interaktif (USART2 PA2/PA3)
- Injeksi Beban Sintetis & Audit Register
Set Tarif ToU, Kontrak, IDPEL & Sync RTC (Cls 8)
